messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal holidays that create a 3‑day long weekend in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re planning for a specific province, keep in mind that many provinces add their own holidays—see the “Provincial notes” section at the end.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | **Feb 20** | Monday | **Feb 18–20** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| 2 | **Good Friday** | **Apr 7** | Friday | **Apr 7–9** | Friday + weekend. |
| 3 | **Victoria Day** | **May 22** | Monday | **May 20–22** | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday. |
| 4 | **Labour Day** | **Sep 4** | Monday | **Sep 2–4** | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday. |
| 5 | **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 9** | Monday | **Oct 7–9** | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday. |
| 6 | **Christmas Day** | **Dec 25** | Monday | **Dec 23–25** | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday. |

### What’s *not* a long weekend in 2023

| Holiday | Date | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Already a weekend day. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Already a weekend day. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Already a weekend day. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Falls on a weekday; no 3‑day stretch. |

### Provincial / Territorial notes

| Province/Territory | Extra holiday that can create a long weekend in 2023 |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Ontario | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17) – Monday → Mar 15–17 |
| British Columbia | **St. George’s Day** (Mar 23) – Monday → Mar 21–23 |
| New Brunswick | **St. John’s Day** (Jun 24) – Monday → Jun 22–24 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17) – Monday → Mar 15–17 |
| Saskatchewan | **Saskatchewan Day** (Jun 21) – Monday → Jun 19–21 |
| ... | (See each province’s statutory holiday calendar for full details.) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want a *complete* list for a particular province, you’ll need to merge the federal list above with that province’s statutory holidays. Many provinces publish their holiday calendars online (e.g., the Government of Ontario’s “Public Holidays” page).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial holiday list for a specific region!
